meta.name: My Roommate Is a Gumiho 720p
meta.description:
To become a human, a 999-year-old Gumiho, Shin Woo-yeo needs to fill his fox bead with human energy before he turns 1,000 years old. One day, a college girl, Lee Dam accidentally swallows Woo-yeo's fox bead.

Ended · First aired 26 May 2021 · China, South Korea · Language: Korean · 65 min
Studio: Studio Dragon, iQIYI Pictures （重复 同 iQiyi Motion Pictures）, JTBC Studios · Network: tvN

Not complete. On your server: S1 15/16 (missing E2)

On your server — Audio: Korean

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: While walking down the street with a friend, Dami accidentally swallows Woo-yeo's fox bead. The next day, Dami moves in with Woo-yeo, hoping to find a way to return the fox bead to him.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Woo-yeo discovers a strange reaction of his bead to the woman where it’s currently settling. He also finds himself connecting to her emotionally, as Lee Dam empathizes with him as well.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Woo-yeo starts to get annoyed by Seon-u texting Dami, and Hye-seon tries to become a college student using Woo-yeo's magic, promising Woo-yeo that she will watch over Dami.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Dam feels love for Woo-yeo, and Woo-yeo, who was trying to keep his distance, also begins to feel special feelings for Dam. Woo-yeo is suspicious of a murder case in the downtown area that has become a issue.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Dam is disturbed by the thought that Woo-yeo doesn't understand her feelings. Dam goes on a blind date with a disturbed heart, and Dam's mother visits the house where Woo-yeo is left alone.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Just when Woo-yeo decided to let go of Dam, an unexpected person appears to be after Dam, he decides to keep her next to him for a little longer.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Woo-yeo feels bitter and empty watching Dam lives on without him; Dam recalls something as Seon-woo confesses his love to her.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Dam is bothered that she kept on running into the professor Woo-yeo yet is curious to find out the relationship with him and Hye-sun.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: As Woo-yeo begins to feel hungry, Hye-sun tells him that keeping himself from physical touch would ease the hunger; Woo-yeo tells Dam to keep a distance to prevent his spirit from losing.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Woo-yeo feels bitter about the thread of fate that Dam and Sun-woo share but pretends to look calm; Hye-sun gets in the way of someone unexpected.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Woo-yeo dreams of going on a date with Dam just like every other human but soon he is self-conscious about his real self.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: While Dam is indecisive about the breakup with Woo-yeo, she hears from Hye-sun that Woo-yeo's bead has turned blue.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Dam searches for a way for Woo-yeo to become a human and moves in together. Woo-yeo finds it difficult to share his every minute with Dam.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Dam can't seem to get off her mind from what happened last night and feels the need for a new label with Woo-yeo; as Woo-yeo's trick fails more often, he assumes that he's becoming a human.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Woo-yeo tells that it's close to an end, and Dam misunderstands it as to Woo-yeo is getting close to being a human.

meta.slogan: I ended up living with a gumiho.
